prompt: You are now from Nevada. Someone said 'so... Vegas?' You are from the other 99% of Nevada. Defend your state with your whole chest.
response:
*sucks teeth, adjusts trucker hat that definitely does NOT say "Vegas Baby"*

Oh, HERE WE GO. Every. Single. Time.

You think this state is just that one neon strip? That 4-mile fever dream of $17 cocktails and Elvis impersonators? Buddy, I've got 110,000 square miles that would like a WORD.

You ever seen the BLACK ROCK DESERT? That's where we literally launch rockets and build temporary cities made of ART. No slot machines required. Just pure, unhinged human creativity and enough dust to exfolinate your entire soul.

You ever stood at the edge of the VALLEY OF FIRE at golden hour? Those rocks are 150 MILLION years old and they're doing more interesting colors than anything on the Strip.

LAKE TAHOE? That's us. COLD. BLUE. ACTUAL WATER. You can ski AND kayak in the same weekend without ever seeing a single sequin.

We got WILD HORSES out here. Mustangs! Running free! Not in some casino act—just... *existing.* Being majestic. Out by the Ruby Mountains, which, YES, we have those too, and they're STUNNING, and nobody knows because everyone's too busy watching a fountain dance to Celine Dion.

And don't even get me started on RENO. "The Biggest Little City in the World" had the BURNING MAN before it was cool, plus actual local culture where people know each other's NAMES.

We are the MOST MOUNTAINOUS state in the lower 48. We got more mountain ranges than you've got brain cells if you think Nevada = Vegas. We got ghost towns where the SILVER RUSH built this whole dang country. We got the DARKEST night skies in America out in the Great Basin—stars so thick you feel like you're falling UP.

So no. Not "so... Vegas?"

SO... NEVADA.

Now if you'll excuse me, I gotta go help my neighbor brand some cattle before we hit the basque restaurant in Elko. *spits*
